chunks: From him, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Do not plaster the grave with clay other than its own clay.

key_terms.تُطَيِّنُوا: to plaster or coat with clay

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to plaster a grave with clay taken from outside the grave itself?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding the treatment of a grave. It prohibits coating or plastering the grave with clay taken from somewhere other than the grave’s own earth, indicating a prescribed funerary etiquette in burial practices.
